messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The image resizer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-11-26, having moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
    earlier: The image resizer is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-20. [valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the image resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- On 2026-03-17 the Atlas team decided that the image resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- On 2025-10-15 the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-15]
- Dashboards and alerts for the image resizer are being repointed as of the 2025-11-26 handover. [valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
- Oskar wrote up the handover doc for the feature-flags service handover to the Atlas team for Farah. [valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: Oskar wrote up the handover doc for the feature-flags service handover to the Dune team for Farah. [valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
- The indexer was owned by the Atlas team from 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder, until ownership transferred to the Boreal team on 2026-04-01. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- On 2026-04-01, ownership of the indexer transferred from the Atlas team to the Boreal team. [valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- On 2025-12-25 the Atlas team noticed that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and flagged it because it is not their service. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- On 2026-04-16 the Atlas team noticed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change and flagged it because it is not their service. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- As of 2025-07-17, the ledger service remains owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-07-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-17]
- As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team is taking over the product catalog from the Cinder team. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- The billing API was owned by the Atlas team from 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team, until ownership transferred to the Ember team on 2026-01-12. [decision; valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-12-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it. [valid 2025-07-03 to 2026-01-12; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-06-09 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-07. [valid 2025-03-07 to 2025-06-09; recorded by handover/2025-03-07-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-07; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- As of 2025-10-13, ownership of the ledger service transferred to Cinder from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- The product catalog is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-12-19, having moved from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
    earlier: Cinder owns the product catalog. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- On 2026-05-27 the Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
